title: Inworld Realtime TTS-2: Emotional AI Speech System
summary: A low-latency conversational voice AI that dynamically adapts its tone and emotional expression based on user audio input. It features a 'behavioral layer' for social reasoning and supports natural language steering across over 100 languages.
research_notes: Developed by Inworld AI; it consistently ranks at the top of the Artificial Analysis Speech Arena and competes directly with OpenAI's Realtime API.

evolution.summary: Launched in May 2026 as a major upgrade from version 1.5, moving beyond simple audio fidelity to emotional context awareness. It is currently in research preview and serves as a benchmark for conversational AI latency and expressiveness.
